paper.title: The End of Optimism? An Asymptotic Analysis of Finite-Armed Linear Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Stochastic finite-armed linear bandit with Gaussian noise
unmapped: Noise is standard Gaussian N(0,1); upper bound said to extend to 1-subgaussian
settings.definition_quote: Let $\mathcal A \subset \R^d$ be a finite set that spans $\R^d$ with $|\mathcal A| = k$ and $\norm{x}_2 \leq 1$ for all $x \in \cA$. A learner interacts with the bandit over $n$ rounds. In each round $t$ the learner chooses an action (arm) $A_t \in \mathcal A$ and observes a payoff $Y_t = \inner{A_t, \theta} + \eta_t$ where $\eta_t \sim \mathcal N(0,1)$ is Gaussian noise

symbols.C_lin: c(A,theta): value of inf_alpha sum_{x suboptimal} alpha(x) Delta_x s.t. ||x||^2_{H(alpha)^{-1}} <= Delta_x^2/2 for all suboptimal x

source.label: cor:regretlb
source.quote: Let $\pi$ be a consistent policy, $\theta\in \R^d$ such that there is a unique optimal arm in $\cA$. Then ... and also $\displaystyle \limsup_{n\to\infty} \frac{R_\theta^\pi(n)}{\log(n)} \geq c(\mathcal A, \theta)$, where $c(\mathcal A, \theta)$ is defined as the solution to the following optimisation problem: inf_{alpha} sum alpha(x) Delta_x subject to ||x||^2_{H^{-1}(alpha)} <= Delta_x^2/2

results.notes: Statement uses limsup; the appendix proof actually establishes the liminf version. Expression is asymptotic regret ~ C_lin log T.

symbols.C_lin: c(A,theta): value of the lower-bound optimisation problem of Corollary 2

source.label: thm:upper
source.quote: Assuming that $x^*$ is unique, the strategy given in Algorithm \ref{alg:optimal} satisfies \limsup_{n\to\infty} \frac{R^\pi_\theta(n)}{\log(n)} \leq c(\mathcal A, \theta) for all \theta \in \R^d.

results.notes: Algorithm takes horizon n as input. Matches lower bound of Corollary 2. Theorem numbering assumed from shared counter.
